newsitem.title: POLAND: FINMIN DIRECTOR FEDEROWICZ HEADS PEKAO BOARD.
newsitem.headline: FINMIN DIRECTOR FEDEROWICZ HEADS PEKAO BOARD.

text.p: Polish state-owned Pekao SA's supervisory board has chosen Wieslaw Federowicz, the director of the finance ministry's banking department, as its chairman, the bank on Wedenesday.
The post was vacant since last year, when Krzysztof Kalicki quit the board to become the deputy president of the bank's management baord.
The bank said in a statment that Piotr Dziewulski, the director of the ministry's public debt department, had been chosen as the board's deputy head at its meeting on April 16.
